description: This Java class 'WearableListItemLayout' extends LinearLayout and implements WearableListView.OnCenterProximityListener to provide custom layout behavior for wearable list items, including handling proximity changes (centered vs non-centered) to animate visual properties like color and transparency.

classes.name: WearableListItemLayout
classes.description: Custom layout class for wearable list items that changes appearance based on proximity in the list view.

methods.name: WearableListItemLayout
methods.description: Constructors for initializing the layout, with different overloads for various parameter sets.

methods.name: onFinishInflate
methods.description: Initializes member views after inflation from XML.

methods.name: onCenterPosition
methods.description: Handles behavior when the list item is in the center position, setting alpha and color.

methods.name: onNonCenterPosition
methods.description: Handles behavior when the list item is not in the center position, updating color and transparency.
